So actually, I might turn the tables a little bit to you because it was your idea to have a frontier team. Yeah. I mean, yeah, the frontier team, I think has been a huge unlock and it's because of this separation that, that I've been talking about. I think there's so many people at every like me who just love playing with new things and that's super important. But if that's all you're doing, then you're, you're not going to make progress as a business. Like you actually do need to go execute on products and services, things that people can rely on. And it felt like we needed to choose one or the other. Yeah. either just constantly be playing with new stuff or make a product that we just build once and then we add features to and we support forever. And the Frontier team was in a sort of an attempt to say, okay, what if we take all the people like me who love all the new stuff and we just unleash us to just run experiments?
